voice_check: Every new line is compared with reference.wav (WeSpeaker voiceprint) and voiced again, steadier, if it scores under 0.70.
why: Replaces speaker 908, whose clone was unstable (0.62 match to his own recording; his line drifted into Ren's voice twice). Speaker 2300 clones faithfully (0.78, as well as Ren and Bex), is clearly a different man from both (0.48 against Ren, 0.45 against Bex), and has the second-widest expressive range in the library.
chosen_from: the 12 auditions (4 per host) of the best-matching male voices among 60 LibriTTS-R speakers, re-ranked by how faithfully each clones

measured_on_reference_line.line: Wait, they used a dozen cans of pepper spray on one man?

source.credit: Voice of LibriTTS-R speaker 2300. LibriTTS-R by Y. Koizumi et al. (2023), CC BY 4.0, derived from LibriTTS (H. Zen et al.) and LibriSpeech/LibriVox recordings.
